frase_gancho.texto: The ceremonial heart of the Mexica empire, open to the sky.

introduccion_narrativa.texto: You step out into the Sacred Precinct of Tenochtitlan, the ritual center of the Mexica world. There are seven open-air stops. You begin at the entrance, where the navel of the universe is explained, and continue with the seven construction stages of the temple, the two shrines at the summit, stage two with the Chac Mool, the stairway of Coyolxauhqui, the wall of skulls, and the Red Temples together with the House of the Eagles. At the end of the walkway you will enter the museum. There is little shade and some narrow walkways, so bring water, a cap, and comfortable shoes.
